bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be no bigger than A4 (21cm x 30cm x 19cm) with at most 2 compartments. Rucksacks are not permitted.
allowed: Bags up to A4 (21cm x 30cm x 19cm) with a maximum of 2 compartments
bagPolicy.note: There are no exceptions to the bag policy. Oversized bags can go in the external Bag Store for £15 per item (card or phone only) after a full search. The Bag Store may not open at every event.

parking.note: Utilita Arena Birmingham offers convenient parking options with North, South, and West car parks. Pre-booking is recommended to secure a spot, especially for the West car park, which is reserved for pre-booked and Premium customers. Accessible parking is available in designated areas.

rideshare.note: If you arrive by car or taxi and don't need parking, get dropped off at the bottom of the main steps on King Edward's Road, then follow the boardwalk to Entrance E.

concessions.note: Utilita Arena Birmingham offers a range of food and drink options, including pre-show dining and interval drinks in their Premium lounges. Visitors can enjoy a variety of bites and beverages without missing any of the action.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking bays are located on Level 9 of the North Car Park, off King Edward's Road, close to Entrance G.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. Once your ticket is scanned and you are inside, you cannot leave and come back, so bring everything you need.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are mobile only and appear in the app from where you bought them. The box office is on the Arena Floor level to the right of Entrance E, opens on event days (usually around 4PM for evening shows), and is closed on non-show days. If you can't use the app, bring your order confirmation and photo ID to the box office to have tickets printed for a fee.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The most direct, level access route is via the boardwalk to Entrance E. If queuing for a long time is difficult for you, tell a steward at the entrance right away and they will arrange priority access.
